//@version=5
strategy("My Custom Intraday Strategy", overlay=true, initial_capital=500000, default_qty_value=75)

// Strategy Inputs
target_r     = input.float(1.5, title="Profit Target (R-Multiple)", step=0.1)
sl_atr_mult  = input.float(1.5, title="Stop Loss (ATR Multiplier)", step=0.1)
atr_period   = input.int(14, title="ATR Period")
trade_window = input.session("0925-1430", title="Allowed Entry Window (IST)")
exit_time    = input.session("1515-1520", title="Mandatory MIS Auto-Exit (IST)")

atr_val  = ta.atr(atr_period)
vwap_val = ta.vwap(hlc3)

// Entry Conditions
in_entry = not na(time(timeframe.period, trade_window + ":1234567"))
is_exit  = not na(time(timeframe.period, exit_time + ":1234567"))
in_pos   = strategy.position_size != 0

long_cond  = not in_pos and in_entry and (close > vwap_val)
short_cond = not in_pos and in_entry and (close < vwap_val)

if long_cond
    sl_dist = atr_val * sl_atr_mult
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
    strategy.exit("Exit_Long", from_entry="Long", stop=close - sl_dist, limit=close + (sl_dist * target_r))

if is_exit and in_pos
    strategy.close_all(comment="MIS_Auto_Squareoff")

// This Pine Script™ code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © NSE Quant Studio — #1 Apex Trend-Momentum Symphony v2 (5m & 15m Auto-Adaptive + Visual Callout Engine)

//@version=5
strategy("Apex Trend-Momentum Symphony v2 [NSE Quant Studio]", shorttitle="Apex Symphony v2", overlay=true, initial_capital=500000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=75, currency=currency.INR, commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_order, commission_value=0.0, calc_on_every_tick=false, process_orders_on_close=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500)

// ============================================================================
// 1. TIMEFRAME PROFILE & STRATEGY INPUTS
// ============================================================================
grp_prof     = "0. Timeframe Optimization Profile"
profileMode  = input.string("Auto (5m & 15m+ Optimized)", "Parameter Profile Mode", options=["Auto (5m & 15m+ Optimized)", "Force 5m Scalper Profile", "Force 15m Swing Profile", "Custom Manual Inputs"], group=grp_prof)

grp_st       = "1. Supertrend Settings (Manual Override)"
stPeriodIn   = input.int(14, "Supertrend ATR Length (5m=14, 15m=10)", minval=1, group=grp_st)
stMultIn     = input.float(3.5, "Supertrend Multiplier (5m=3.5, 15m=3.0)", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=grp_st)

grp_ema      = "2. 3-EMA Trend Ribbon (Manual Override)"
emaFastIn    = input.int(9, "Fast EMA Length (5m=9, 15m=8)", minval=1, group=grp_ema)
emaSlowIn    = input.int(21, "Slow EMA Length (21)", minval=1, group=grp_ema)
emaMacIn     = input.int(50, "Macro EMA Length (5m=50, 15m=55)", minval=1, group=grp_ema)

grp_mom      = "3. Intraday VWAP, RSI & ADX Chop Filter"
rsiLen       = input.int(14, "RSI Length", minval=1, group=grp_mom)
rsiLongIn    = input.float(58.0, "RSI Long Threshold (5m=58, 15m=52)", minval=50.0, maxval=80.0, step=0.5, group=grp_mom)
rsiShortIn   = input.float(42.0, "RSI Short Threshold (5m=42, 15m=48)", minval=20.0, maxval=50.0, step=0.5, group=grp_mom)
adxLen       = input.int(14, "ADX Chop Filter Length", minval=1, group=grp_mom)
adxMinIn     = input.float(16.0, "Minimum ADX Trend Strength (0 = Off)", minval=0.0, maxval=50.0, step=1.0, group=grp_mom)
maxLegIn     = input.int(2, "Max Entries Per Supertrend Wave", minval=1, maxval=20, group=grp_mom)
vwapMode     = input.string("Equal-Weighted (Nifty Spot)", "Intraday Anchor Mode", options=["Equal-Weighted (Nifty Spot)", "Volume-Weighted VWAP"], group=grp_mom)

grp_risk     = "4. Two-Stage Ratchet, Target & Trailing Stop"
atrLen       = input.int(14, "Stop ATR Length", minval=1, group=grp_risk)
slAtrIn      = input.float(1.8, "Initial Stop Loss x ATR (5m=1.8, 15m=1.6)", minval=0.2, step=0.1, group=grp_risk)
minAtrFloor  = input.float(15.0, "Minimum ATR Floor (Nifty Pts)", minval=0.0, step=1.0, group=grp_risk)
beTrigIn     = input.float(1.0, "Stage-1 Breakeven Trigger (x R)", minval=0.0, step=0.1, group=grp_risk)
beOffIn      = input.float(0.25, "Stage-1 Breakeven Lock Offset (+x R)", minval=0.0, step=0.05, group=grp_risk)
lock2TrigIn  = input.float(2.0, "Stage-2 Profit-Lock Trigger (x R)", minval=0.0, step=0.1, group=grp_risk)
lock2OffIn   = input.float(1.10, "Stage-2 Profit-Lock Offset (+x R)", minval=0.0, step=0.05, group=grp_risk)
tpRIn        = input.float(3.5, "Profit Target Multiple (x R, 5m=3.5, 15m=4.5, 0=Off)", minval=0.0, step=0.1, group=grp_risk)
useStTrail   = input.bool(true, "Enable Live Supertrend Trailing Stop", group=grp_risk)

grp_vis      = "5. Visual Callout Engine & HUD (Image 2 Style)"
showCallouts = input.bool(true, "Show BUY CALL / BUY PUT & EXIT PnL Badges", group=grp_vis)
entryStyle   = input.string("Solid Blue (Image 2 Style)", "Entry Badge Color Theme", options=["Solid Blue (Image 2 Style)", "Green Call / Red Put"], group=grp_vis)
displayLots  = input.int(1, "Badge Display Qty (Lots)", minval=1, group=grp_vis)
lotSize      = input.int(75, "Nifty Lot Size (Units per Lot)", minval=1, group=grp_vis)
showRibbons  = input.bool(false, "Show Background EMA Ribbon Lines", group=grp_vis)
showStLine   = input.bool(true, "Show Supertrend Spine Line", group=grp_vis)
showTradeLvls= input.bool(true, "Show Active Entry / Stop / Target Lines", group=grp_vis)
showHud      = input.bool(true, "Show Quant Studio Telemetry HUD Table", group=grp_vis)
intradayOnly = input.bool(false, "Strict Intraday MIS Mode (Flat at 15:15 IST)", group=grp_vis)

// ============================================================================
// 2. AUTO-ADAPTIVE PARAMETER RESOLUTION (5m vs 15m+)
// ============================================================================
is5mChart = timeframe.isminutes and timeframe.multiplier <= 5
use5mProf = (profileMode == "Force 5m Scalper Profile") or (profileMode == "Auto (5m & 15m+ Optimized)" and is5mChart)
use15mProf= (profileMode == "Force 15m Swing Profile") or (profileMode == "Auto (5m & 15m+ Optimized)" and not is5mChart)

stPeriod    = use5mProf ? 14   : use15mProf ? 10   : stPeriodIn
stMult      = use5mProf ? 3.5  : use15mProf ? 3.0  : stMultIn
emaFastP    = use5mProf ? 9    : use15mProf ? 8    : emaFastIn
emaSlowP    = use5mProf ? 21   : use15mProf ? 21   : emaSlowIn
emaMacP     = use5mProf ? 50   : use15mProf ? 55   : emaMacIn
rsiLong     = use5mProf ? 58.0 : use15mProf ? 52.0 : rsiLongIn
rsiShort    = use5mProf ? 42.0 : use15mProf ? 48.0 : rsiShortIn
adxMin      = use5mProf ? 16.0 : use15mProf ? 16.0 : adxMinIn
maxLegTrades= use5mProf ? 2    : use15mProf ? 2    : maxLegIn
slAtrMult   = use5mProf ? 1.8  : use15mProf ? 1.6  : slAtrIn
beTriggerR  = use5mProf ? 1.0  : use15mProf ? 1.1  : beTrigIn
beOffsetR   = use5mProf ? 0.25 : use15mProf ? 0.20 : beOffIn
lock2TrigR  = use5mProf ? 2.0  : use15mProf ? 2.2  : lock2TrigIn
lock2OffR   = use5mProf ? 1.10 : use15mProf ? 1.20 : lock2OffIn
tpR         = use5mProf ? 3.5  : use15mProf ? 4.5  : tpRIn

// ============================================================================
// 3. CORE INDICATORS (SUPERTREND, 3-EMA, INTRADAY VWAP, RSI, ADX)
// ============================================================================
emaFast = ta.ema(close, emaFastP)
emaSlow = ta.ema(close, emaSlowP)
emaMac  = ta.ema(close, emaMacP)
rsiVal  = ta.rsi(close, rsiLen)

trVal   = ta.tr(true)
atr14   = ta.rma(trVal, atrLen)
curAtr  = math.max(nz(atr14, minAtrFloor), minAtrFloor)

// Wilder's ADX (14) Calculation (100% Native & Non-Repainting)
upMove   = high - nz(high[1], high)
dnMove   = nz(low[1], low) - low
plusDm   = (upMove > dnMove and upMove > 0) ? upMove : 0.0
minusDm  = (dnMove > upMove and dnMove > 0) ? dnMove : 0.0
adxAtr   = nz(ta.rma(trVal, adxLen), 1.0)
plusDi   = 100.0 * nz(ta.rma(plusDm, adxLen), 0.0) / math.max(adxAtr, 0.0001)
minusDi  = 100.0 * nz(ta.rma(minusDm, adxLen), 0.0) / math.max(adxAtr, 0.0001)
diSum    = plusDi + minusDi
dxVal    = diSum > 0 ? (100.0 * math.abs(plusDi - minusDi) / diSum) : 0.0
adxVal   = nz(ta.rma(dxVal, adxLen), 0.0)

// Exact Supertrend Engine
stAtr      = ta.rma(trVal, stPeriod)
hl2Val     = (high + low) / 2.0
basicUpper = hl2Val + (stMult * nz(stAtr, 0.0))
basicLower = hl2Val - (stMult * nz(stAtr, 0.0))

var float upperBand = na
var float lowerBand = na
var int   stTrend   = 1
var float stLine    = na
var int   legTrades = 0

if na(stAtr) or na(upperBand[1]) or bar_index <= stPeriod
    upperBand := basicUpper
    lowerBand := basicLower
    stTrend   := 1
    stLine    := basicLower
else
    upperBand := (basicUpper < upperBand[1] or close[1] > upperBand[1]) ? basicUpper : upperBand[1]
    lowerBand := (basicLower > lowerBand[1] or close[1] < lowerBand[1]) ? basicLower : lowerBand[1]
    if stTrend[1] == 1
        stTrend := close < lowerBand ? -1 : 1
    else
        stTrend := close > upperBand ? 1 : -1
    stLine := stTrend == 1 ? lowerBand : upperBand

if stTrend != stTrend[1]
    legTrades := 0

// Intraday VWAP (with automatic Nifty Spot zero-volume compatibility)
isNewDay = timeframe.change("D")
var float cumHlc3 = 0.0
var int   cumBars = 0
var float cumPv   = 0.0
var float cumVol  = 0.0
volSafe = nz(volume, 0.0)

if isNewDay or bar_index == 0
    cumHlc3 := hlc3
    cumBars := 1
    cumPv   := hlc3 * volSafe
    cumVol  := volSafe
else
    cumHlc3 += hlc3
    cumBars += 1
    cumPv   += hlc3 * volSafe
    cumVol  += volSafe

eqWeightedVwap  = cumHlc3 / cumBars
volWeightedVwap = cumVol > 0 ? (cumPv / cumVol) : eqWeightedVwap
intradayVwap    = (vwapMode == "Equal-Weighted (Nifty Spot)") ? eqWeightedVwap : volWeightedVwap

// IST Session Helper
istHour        = hour(time, "Asia/Kolkata")
istMinute      = minute(time, "Asia/Kolkata")
tInt           = istHour * 100 + istMinute
inEntryWindow  = not intradayOnly or (tInt >= 920 and tInt <= 1430)
isMisSquareoff = intradayOnly and (tInt >= 1515)

// ============================================================================
// 4. ENTRY & TWO-STAGE RATCHET EXIT ENGINE
// ============================================================================
var float entryPrice  = na
var float initRisk    = na
var float activeStop  = na
var float activeTp    = na
var int   ratchetStage= 0

inLong  = strategy.position_size > 0
inShort = strategy.position_size < 0
inPos   = strategy.position_size != 0

if inLong
    if beTriggerR > 0 and not na(entryPrice) and not na(initRisk) and high >= (entryPrice + initRisk * beTriggerR)
        longBeStop = math.round((entryPrice + initRisk * beOffsetR) * 100.0) / 100.0
        if na(activeStop) or longBeStop > activeStop
            activeStop   := longBeStop
            ratchetStage := math.max(ratchetStage, 1)
    if lock2TrigR > 0 and not na(entryPrice) and not na(initRisk) and high >= (entryPrice + initRisk * lock2TrigR)
        longL2Stop = math.round((entryPrice + initRisk * lock2OffR) * 100.0) / 100.0
        if na(activeStop) or longL2Stop > activeStop
            activeStop   := longL2Stop
            ratchetStage := math.max(ratchetStage, 2)
    if useStTrail and stTrend == 1 and not na(stLine) and (na(activeStop) or stLine > activeStop)
        activeStop := math.round(stLine * 100.0) / 100.0
    if tpR > 0 and not na(activeTp)
        strategy.exit("Long Exit", from_entry="Long", stop=activeStop, limit=activeTp)
    else
        strategy.exit("Long Exit", from_entry="Long", stop=activeStop)
    if isMisSquareoff
        strategy.close("Long")
    else if stTrend == -1 and emaFast < emaSlow
        strategy.close("Long")

if inShort
    if beTriggerR > 0 and not na(entryPrice) and not na(initRisk) and low <= (entryPrice - initRisk * beTriggerR)
        shortBeStop = math.round((entryPrice - initRisk * beOffsetR) * 100.0) / 100.0
        if na(activeStop) or shortBeStop < activeStop
            activeStop   := shortBeStop
            ratchetStage := math.max(ratchetStage, 1)
    if lock2TrigR > 0 and not na(entryPrice) and not na(initRisk) and low <= (entryPrice - initRisk * lock2TrigR)
        shortL2Stop = math.round((entryPrice - initRisk * lock2OffR) * 100.0) / 100.0
        if na(activeStop) or shortL2Stop < activeStop
            activeStop   := shortL2Stop
            ratchetStage := math.max(ratchetStage, 2)
    if useStTrail and stTrend == -1 and not na(stLine) and (na(activeStop) or stLine < activeStop)
        activeStop := math.round(stLine * 100.0) / 100.0
    if tpR > 0 and not na(activeTp)
        strategy.exit("Short Exit", from_entry="Short", stop=activeStop, limit=activeTp)
    else
        strategy.exit("Short Exit", from_entry="Short", stop=activeStop)
    if isMisSquareoff
        strategy.close("Short")
    else if stTrend == 1 and emaFast > emaSlow
        strategy.close("Short")

// Impulse Trigger: 5m uses Tri-Trigger (ST flip OR EMA cross OR RSI cross); 15m uses ST flip OR RSI cross
freshBullTrigger = use5mProf ? ((stTrend[1] == -1) or (emaFast[1] <= emaSlow[1]) or (rsiVal[1] <= rsiLong)) : ((stTrend[1] == -1) or (rsiVal[1] <= rsiLong))
freshBearTrigger = use5mProf ? ((stTrend[1] == 1)  or (emaFast[1] >= emaSlow[1]) or (rsiVal[1] >= rsiShort)) : ((stTrend[1] == 1)  or (rsiVal[1] >= rsiShort))
adxOk            = (adxMin <= 0.0) or (adxVal >= adxMin)

longCond  = bar_index >= 55 and inEntryWindow and (legTrades < maxLegTrades) and stTrend == 1  and emaFast > emaSlow and close > emaMac and close > intradayVwap and rsiVal > rsiLong  and adxOk and freshBullTrigger
shortCond = bar_index >= 55 and inEntryWindow and (legTrades < maxLegTrades) and stTrend == -1 and emaFast < emaSlow and close < emaMac and close < intradayVwap and rsiVal < rsiShort and adxOk and freshBearTrigger

flatNow = (strategy.position_size == 0) or (inLong and (isMisSquareoff or (stTrend == -1 and emaFast < emaSlow))) or (inShort and (isMisSquareoff or (stTrend == 1 and emaFast > emaSlow)))

bool enteredLongBar  = false
bool enteredShortBar = false

if flatNow and not isMisSquareoff
    if longCond
        entryPrice     := close
        initRisk       := curAtr * slAtrMult
        activeStop     := math.round((entryPrice - initRisk) * 100.0) / 100.0
        activeTp       := tpR > 0 ? (math.round((entryPrice + initRisk * tpR) * 100.0) / 100.0) : na
        ratchetStage   := 0
        legTrades      += 1
        enteredLongBar := true
        strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
        if tpR > 0 and not na(activeTp)
            strategy.exit("Long Exit", from_entry="Long", stop=activeStop, limit=activeTp)
        else
            strategy.exit("Long Exit", from_entry="Long", stop=activeStop)
    else if shortCond
        entryPrice      := close
        initRisk        := curAtr * slAtrMult
        activeStop      := math.round((entryPrice + initRisk) * 100.0) / 100.0
        activeTp        := tpR > 0 ? (math.round((entryPrice - initRisk * tpR) * 100.0) / 100.0) : na
        ratchetStage    := 0
        legTrades       += 1
        enteredShortBar := true
        strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
        if tpR > 0 and not na(activeTp)
            strategy.exit("Short Exit", from_entry="Short", stop=activeStop, limit=activeTp)
        else
            strategy.exit("Short Exit", from_entry="Short", stop=activeStop)

// ============================================================================
// 5. IMAGE 2 VISUAL CALLOUT ENGINE (BUY CALL / BUY PUT & EXIT PnL BADGES)
// ============================================================================
// Detect newly closed trades and render green/red EXIT PnL pills (exact Image 2 style)
closedCount = strategy.closedtrades
prevClosed  = nz(closedCount[1], 0)

if showCallouts and closedCount > prevClosed
    for idx = prevClosed to closedCount - 1
        exPrice  = strategy.closedtrades.exit_price(idx)
        enPrice  = strategy.closedtrades.entry_price(idx)
        trSize   = strategy.closedtrades.size(idx)
        ptsDiff  = trSize > 0 ? (exPrice - enPrice) : (enPrice - exPrice)
        isWin    = ptsDiff >= 0
        signStr  = isWin ? "+" : ""
        pillClr  = isWin ? #10b981 : #f43f5e
        exitTxt  = "EXIT\n" + signStr + str.tostring(ptsDiff, "0.0") + " pts"
        wasLong  = trSize > 0
        yExitPos = wasLong ? (high + curAtr * 0.25) : (low - curAtr * 0.25)
        lblStyle = wasLong ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up
        label.new(bar_index, yExitPos, exitTxt, xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, color=pillClr, textcolor=color.white, style=lblStyle, size=size.small)

// Render Entry Callout Boxes on the entry bar (exact Image 2 style)
if showCallouts and enteredLongBar
    callClr = (entryStyle == "Solid Blue (Image 2 Style)") ? #2563eb : #059669
    callTxt = "BUY CALL\nEntry: " + str.tostring(entryPrice, "0.00") + "\nQty: " + str.tostring(displayLots)
    label.new(bar_index, low - curAtr * 0.35, callTxt, xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, color=callClr, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.small)

if showCallouts and enteredShortBar
    putClr  = (entryStyle == "Solid Blue (Image 2 Style)") ? #2563eb : #e11d48
    putTxt  = "BUY PUT\nEntry: " + str.tostring(entryPrice, "0.00") + "\nQty: " + str.tostring(displayLots)
    label.new(bar_index, high + curAtr * 0.35, putTxt, xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, color=putClr, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)

// Subtle directional triangles on entry bars
plotshape(enteredLongBar, title="Buy Call Marker", style=shape.triangleup, location=location.belowbar, color=#3b82f6, size=size.tiny)
plotshape(enteredShortBar, title="Buy Put Marker", style=shape.triangledown, location=location.abovebar, color=#f59e0b, size=size.tiny)

// Clean Chart Overlays
plot(showRibbons ? emaFast : na, "Fast EMA", color=color.new(#06b6d4, 55), linewidth=1)
plot(showRibbons ? emaSlow : na, "Slow EMA", color=color.new(#f59e0b, 55), linewidth=1)
plot(showRibbons ? emaMac  : na, "Macro EMA", color=color.new(#818cf8, 60), linewidth=2)
plot(showRibbons ? intradayVwap : na, "Intraday VWAP", color=color.new(#e879f9, 55), linewidth=1, style=plot.style_circles)

stColor = stTrend == 1 ? color.new(#10b981, 25) : color.new(#f43f5e, 25)
plot(showStLine ? stLine : na, "Supertrend Spine", color=stColor, linewidth=2)

// Active Trade Horizontal Level Lines (Image 2 Clean Style)
inTradeNow = strategy.position_size != 0
plot(showTradeLvls and inTradeNow ? entryPrice : na, "Active Entry Price", color=color.new(#60a5fa, 20), linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showTradeLvls and inTradeNow ? activeStop : na, "Active Ratchet / Trail Stop", color=color.new(#fbbf24, 0), linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showTradeLvls and inTradeNow and tpR > 0 ? activeTp : na, "Active Profit Target", color=color.new(#10b981, 20), linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

// ============================================================================
// 6. QUANT STUDIO TELEMETRY HUD TABLE
// ============================================================================
var table hud = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 9, bgcolor=color.new(#0e121b, 8), border_color=color.new(#ffffff, 82), border_width=1)

if barstate.islast and showHud
    totTrades = strategy.closedtrades
    wins      = strategy.wintrades
    winRate   = totTrades > 0 ? (wins / totTrades) * 100.0 : 0.0
    pf        = strategy.grossloss != 0 ? math.abs(strategy.grossprofit / strategy.grossloss) : 0.0
    netInr    = strategy.netprofit
    netPts    = netInr / math.max(lotSize, 1)
    maxDdPts  = strategy.max_drawdown / math.max(lotSize, 1)
    profLabel = use5mProf ? "5M SCALPER [AUTO]" : use15mProf ? "15M SWING [AUTO]" : "MANUAL CUSTOM"
    ratchTxt  = ratchetStage == 2 ? " [LOCK +1.1R]" : ratchetStage == 1 ? " [BE LOCK]" : " [INIT SL]"

    table.cell(hud, 0, 0, "👑 APEX SYMPHONY v2", text_color=#60a5fa, text_size=size.small, bgcolor=color.new(#1e293b, 10), text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 0, profLabel, text_color=#34d399, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(#1e293b, 10), text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 1, "Active Parameters", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 1, "ST(" + str.tostring(stPeriod) + "," + str.tostring(stMult, "0.0") + ") · EMA(" + str.tostring(emaFastP) + "/" + str.tostring(emaSlowP) + "/" + str.tostring(emaMacP) + ")", text_color=#e2e8f0, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 2, "Regime · RSI · ADX", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 2, (stTrend == 1 ? "BULL" : "BEAR") + " · RSI " + str.tostring(rsiVal, "0.0") + " · ADX " + str.tostring(adxVal, "0.0"), text_color=(stTrend == 1 ? #10b981 : #f43f5e), text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 3, "Active Stop / Ratchet", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 3, inTradeNow ? (str.tostring(activeStop, "0.00") + ratchTxt) : "FLAT", text_color=#fbbf24, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 4, "Net Profit (Nifty Pts)", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)

pine_apex_ribbon_v3.code:
// This Pine Script™ code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © NSE Quant Studio — #1 Apex Institutional Ribbon & Volatility Squeeze Engine v3 (5m Optimized)

//@version=5
strategy("Apex Institutional Ribbon & Volatility Squeeze v3 [NSE Quant Studio]", shorttitle="Apex Ribbon v3 [5m]", overlay=true, initial_capital=500000, default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, default_qty_value=75, currency=currency.INR, commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_order, commission_value=0.0, calc_on_every_tick=false, process_orders_on_close=true, max_labels_count=500, max_lines_count=500)

// ============================================================================
// 1. STRATEGY INPUTS & ARCHITECTURE
// ============================================================================
grp_ribbon   = "1. Institutional 4-EMA Ribbon"
emaFastP     = input.int(8, "Fast EMA Length", minval=1, group=grp_ribbon)
emaMedP      = input.int(21, "Transition EMA Length", minval=1, group=grp_ribbon)
emaSlowP     = input.int(55, "Structural Support EMA Length", minval=1, group=grp_ribbon)
emaMacroP    = input.int(200, "Macro Baseline Trend EMA Length", minval=1, group=grp_ribbon)

grp_vol      = "2. Volatility Spread & Money Flow Filters"
spreadMultIn = input.float(1.2, "Minimum Candle Range (x ATR 14)", minval=0.5, step=0.05, group=grp_vol)
cmfThreshIn  = input.float(0.08, "Chaikin Money Flow Threshold", minval=0.0, step=0.01, group=grp_vol)
adxThreshIn  = input.float(20.0, "Minimum ADX Trend Strength", minval=0.0, step=1.0, group=grp_vol)

grp_risk     = "3. Asymmetric Risk, Target & Ratchet"
slAtrMultIn  = input.float(1.5, "Stop Loss Buffer (x ATR below EMA 55)", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=grp_risk)
targetRIn    = input.float(3.5, "Profit Target Multiple (x R)", minval=1.0, step=0.1, group=grp_risk)
beTriggerRIn = input.float(1.2, "Stage-1 Breakeven Trigger (x R)", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=grp_risk)
beLockRIn    = input.float(0.2, "Stage-1 Breakeven Lock (+x R)", minval=0.0, step=0.05, group=grp_risk)
exitEma21    = input.bool(true, "Exit on EMA 21 Structural Close", group=grp_risk)
intradayOnly = input.bool(true, "Strict Intraday MIS Mode (Flat at 15:15 IST)", group=grp_risk)

grp_vis      = "4. Visual Callouts & Telemetry HUD"
showCallouts = input.bool(true, "Show BUY CALL / BUY PUT & EXIT Badges", group=grp_vis)
displayLots  = input.int(1, "Display Qty (Lots)", minval=1, group=grp_vis)
lotSize      = input.int(75, "Nifty Lot Size (Units/Lot)", minval=1, group=grp_vis)
showRibbons  = input.bool(true, "Show 4-EMA Ribbon Lines", group=grp_vis)
showTradeLvls= input.bool(true, "Show Entry / Stop / Target Lines", group=grp_vis)
showHud      = input.bool(true, "Show Quant Studio Telemetry HUD Table", group=grp_vis)

// ============================================================================
// 2. CORE MATHEMATICAL INDICATORS
// ============================================================================
emaFast  = ta.ema(close, emaFastP)
emaMed   = ta.ema(close, emaMedP)
emaSlow  = ta.ema(close, emaSlowP)
emaMacro = ta.ema(close, emaMacroP)

trVal    = ta.tr(true)
atr14    = ta.rma(trVal, 14)
curAtr   = math.max(nz(atr14, 15.0), 15.0)

// Normalized Candle Range Spread (filters low-volume consolidation noise)
candleRange  = high - low
spreadFilter = candleRange >= (curAtr * spreadMultIn)

// Chaikin Money Flow (Equal-Weighted Index Adapted)
mfMultiplier = ((close - low) - (high - close)) / math.max(high - low, 0.001)
cmfVal       = ta.sma(mfMultiplier, 20)

// Wilder's ADX 14
upMove  = high - nz(high[1], high)
dnMove  = nz(low[1], low) - low
plusDm  = (upMove > dnMove and upMove > 0) ? upMove : 0.0
minusDm = (dnMove > upMove and dnMove > 0) ? dnMove : 0.0
adxAtr  = nz(ta.rma(trVal, 14), 1.0)
plusDi  = 100.0 * nz(ta.rma(plusDm, 14), 0.0) / math.max(adxAtr, 0.0001)
minusDi = 100.0 * nz(ta.rma(minusDm, 14), 0.0) / math.max(adxAtr, 0.0001)
diSum   = plusDi + minusDi
dxVal   = diSum > 0 ? (100.0 * math.abs(plusDi - minusDi) / diSum) : 0.0
adxVal  = nz(ta.rma(dxVal, 14), 0.0)

// IST Session Helper
istHour        = hour(time, "Asia/Kolkata")
istMinute      = minute(time, "Asia/Kolkata")
tInt           = istHour * 100 + istMinute
inEntryWindow  = (not intradayOnly) or (tInt >= 920 and tInt <= 1430)
isMisSquareoff = intradayOnly and (tInt >= 1515)

// ============================================================================
// 3. INSTITUTIONAL RIBBON CONFLUENCE CONDITIONS
// ============================================================================
// Perfect Ribbon Stack
bullRibbon = (emaFast > emaMed) and (emaMed > emaSlow) and (close > emaMacro)
bearRibbon = (emaFast < emaMed) and (emaMed < emaSlow) and (close < emaMacro)

// Momentum impulse trigger: price breaks out with range spread expansion and money flow
longCond  = inEntryWindow and bullRibbon and spreadFilter and (cmfVal >= cmfThreshIn) and (adxVal >= adxThreshIn) and (close > emaFast)
shortCond = inEntryWindow and bearRibbon and spreadFilter and (cmfVal <= -cmfThreshIn) and (adxVal >= adxThreshIn) and (close < emaFast)

// ============================================================================
// 4. POSITION MANAGEMENT & DYNAMIC RATCHET EXITS
// ============================================================================
var float entryPrice   = na
var float initRisk     = na
var float activeStop   = na
var float activeTp     = na
var int   ratchetStage = 0

inLong  = strategy.position_size > 0
inShort = strategy.position_size < 0
flatNow = strategy.position_size == 0

// Trade Management: Ratchet Stop & Target
if inLong
    if beTriggerRIn > 0 and not na(entryPrice) and not na(initRisk) and high >= (entryPrice + initRisk * beTriggerRIn)
        beStop = math.round((entryPrice + initRisk * beLockRIn) * 100.0) / 100.0
        if na(activeStop) or beStop > activeStop
            activeStop   := beStop
            ratchetStage := 1

    if not na(activeTp) and not na(activeStop)
        strategy.exit("Long Exit", from_entry="Long", stop=activeStop, limit=activeTp)
    else if not na(activeStop)
        strategy.exit("Long Exit", from_entry="Long", stop=activeStop)

    if isMisSquareoff
        strategy.close("Long", comment="MIS Exit")
    else if exitEma21 and close < emaMed
        strategy.close("Long", comment="EMA21 Trail Exit")

if inShort
    if beTriggerRIn > 0 and not na(entryPrice) and not na(initRisk) and low <= (entryPrice - initRisk * beTriggerRIn)
        beStop = math.round((entryPrice - initRisk * beLockRIn) * 100.0) / 100.0
        if na(activeStop) or beStop < activeStop
            activeStop   := beStop
            ratchetStage := 1

    if not na(activeTp) and not na(activeStop)
        strategy.exit("Short Exit", from_entry="Short", stop=activeStop, limit=activeTp)
    else if not na(activeStop)
        strategy.exit("Short Exit", from_entry="Short", stop=activeStop)

    if isMisSquareoff
        strategy.close("Short", comment="MIS Exit")
    else if exitEma21 and close > emaMed
        strategy.close("Short", comment="EMA21 Trail Exit")

bool enteredLong  = false
bool enteredShort = false

// Entry Execution
if flatNow and not isMisSquareoff
    if longCond
        entryPrice   := close
        rawRisk      = math.max(close - emaSlow + (curAtr * (slAtrMultIn - 1.0)), curAtr * 1.2)
        initRisk     := math.min(math.max(rawRisk, 15.0), 85.0)
        activeStop   := math.round((entryPrice - initRisk) * 100.0) / 100.0
        activeTp     := math.round((entryPrice + initRisk * targetRIn) * 100.0) / 100.0
        ratchetStage := 0
        enteredLong  := true
        strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
        strategy.exit("Long Exit", from_entry="Long", stop=activeStop, limit=activeTp)
    else if shortCond
        entryPrice   := close
        rawRisk      = math.max(emaSlow - close + (curAtr * (slAtrMultIn - 1.0)), curAtr * 1.2)
        initRisk     := math.min(math.max(rawRisk, 15.0), 85.0)
        activeStop   := math.round((entryPrice + initRisk) * 100.0) / 100.0
        activeTp     := math.round((entryPrice - initRisk * targetRIn) * 100.0) / 100.0
        ratchetStage := 0
        enteredShort := true
        strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)
        strategy.exit("Short Exit", from_entry="Short", stop=activeStop, limit=activeTp)

// ============================================================================
// 5. VISUAL CALLOUT ENGINE & OVERLAYS
// ============================================================================
closedCount = strategy.closedtrades
prevClosed  = nz(closedCount[1], 0)

if showCallouts and closedCount > prevClosed
    for idx = prevClosed to closedCount - 1
        exPrice  = strategy.closedtrades.exit_price(idx)
        enPrice  = strategy.closedtrades.entry_price(idx)
        trSize   = strategy.closedtrades.size(idx)
        ptsDiff  = trSize > 0 ? (exPrice - enPrice) : (enPrice - exPrice)
        isWin    = ptsDiff >= 0
        signStr  = isWin ? "+" : ""
        pillClr  = isWin ? #10b981 : #f43f5e
        exitTxt  = "EXIT\n" + signStr + str.tostring(ptsDiff, "0.0") + " pts"
        wasLong  = trSize > 0
        yExitPos = wasLong ? (high + curAtr * 0.25) : (low - curAtr * 0.25)
        lblStyle = wasLong ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up
        label.new(bar_index, yExitPos, exitTxt, xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, color=pillClr, textcolor=color.white, style=lblStyle, size=size.small)

if showCallouts and enteredLong
    label.new(bar_index, low - curAtr * 0.35, "BUY CALL\nEntry: " + str.tostring(entryPrice, "0.00") + "\nQty: " + str.tostring(displayLots), xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, color=#2563eb, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.small)

if showCallouts and enteredShort
    label.new(bar_index, high + curAtr * 0.35, "BUY PUT\nEntry: " + str.tostring(entryPrice, "0.00") + "\nQty: " + str.tostring(displayLots), xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, color=#2563eb, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)

plot(showRibbons ? emaFast  : na, "Fast EMA (8)", color=color.new(#06b6d4, 30), linewidth=1)
plot(showRibbons ? emaMed   : na, "Med EMA (21)", color=color.new(#f59e0b, 30), linewidth=1)
plot(showRibbons ? emaSlow  : na, "Slow EMA (55)", color=color.new(#818cf8, 30), linewidth=2)
plot(showRibbons ? emaMacro : na, "Macro EMA (200)", color=color.new(#ec4899, 40), linewidth=2)

inTradeNow = strategy.position_size != 0
plot(showTradeLvls and inTradeNow ? entryPrice : na, "Active Entry", color=color.new(#60a5fa, 20), linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showTradeLvls and inTradeNow ? activeStop : na, "Active Ratchet Stop", color=color.new(#fbbf24, 0), linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showTradeLvls and inTradeNow ? activeTp   : na, "Active 3.5R Target", color=color.new(#10b981, 20), linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

// ============================================================================
// 6. QUANT STUDIO TELEMETRY HUD TABLE
// ============================================================================
var table hud = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 8, bgcolor=color.new(#0e121b, 8), border_color=color.new(#ffffff, 82), border_width=1)

    wins      = strategy.wintrades
    winRate   = totTrades > 0 ? (wins / totTrades) * 100.0 : 0.0

    netInr    = strategy.netprofit

    table.cell(hud, 1, 0, "INSTITUTIONAL", text_color=#34d399, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(#1e293b, 10), text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 2, "CMF · ADX Strength", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)

pine_institutional_orb_v3.title: ⚡ Institutional Session ORB & Expansion v3 [5m Top #2]

pine_institutional_orb_v3.code:
//@version=5
strategy("Institutional Session ORB & Multi-Stage Expansion [NSE Quant Studio]", 
         shorttitle="Institutional ORB v3 [5m]",
         overlay=true, 
         initial_capital=500000, 
         default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, 
         default_qty_value=75, 
         currency=currency.INR,
         commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_order, 
         commission_value=0.0)

// =============================================================================
// INPUTS & CONFIGURATION
// =============================================================================
grp_orb   = "1. Opening Range Parameters"
or_len    = input.int(15, "Opening Range Duration (Minutes)", options=[15, 30], group=grp_orb)

grp_st    = "2. Supertrend Parameters"
st_period = input.int(10, "Supertrend ATR Period", group=grp_st)
st_mult   = input.float(3.0, "Supertrend Multiplier", step=0.1, group=grp_st)

grp_filt  = "3. Trend & Expansion Filters"
adx_len   = input.int(14, "ADX Period", group=grp_filt)
adx_thres = input.float(20.0, "Minimum ADX Strength", step=1.0, group=grp_filt)
use_vwap  = input.bool(true, "Require VWAP Slope Filter", group=grp_filt)

grp_risk  = "4. Risk & Ratchet Engine"
target_r  = input.float(3.0, "Profit Target (R-Multiple)", step=0.5, group=grp_risk)
be_trig_r = input.float(1.2, "Breakeven Trigger (R-Multiple)", step=0.1, group=grp_risk)
be_lock_r = input.float(0.2, "Breakeven Lock Profit (R-Multiple)", step=0.05, group=grp_risk)
use_trail = input.bool(true, "Dynamic Supertrend Trailing Stop", group=grp_risk)

grp_sess  = "5. Institutional Trading Sessions (IST)"
morn_sess = input.session("0930-1115", "Morning Institutional Window", group=grp_sess)
lunch_nop = input.session("1115-1315", "Lunch Chop No-Trade Zone", group=grp_sess)
aft_sess  = input.session("1315-1445", "Afternoon Institutional Trend", group=grp_sess)
mis_exit  = input.session("1515-1530", "Mandatory MIS Square-Off Time", group=grp_sess)

// =============================================================================
// 1. OPENING RANGE ENGINE (09:15 to 09:30 or 09:45 IST)
// =============================================================================
var float or_high = na
var float or_low  = na
var float or_mid  = na
var int   morn_trades_today = 0
var int   aft_trades_today  = 0

is_new_day = ta.change(time("D")) != 0

if is_new_day
    or_high := na
    or_low  := na
    or_mid  := na
    morn_trades_today := 0
    aft_trades_today  := 0

t_int = hour(time, "Asia/Kolkata") * 100 + minute(time, "Asia/Kolkata")
is_or_calc_bar = (or_len == 15 and t_int >= 915 and t_int < 930) or (or_len == 30 and t_int >= 915 and t_int < 945)

if is_or_calc_bar
    or_high := na(or_high) ? high : math.max(or_high, high)
    or_low  := na(or_low) ? low : math.min(or_low, low)
    or_mid  := (or_high + or_low) / 2.0

plot(not is_or_calc_bar and not na(or_high) ? or_high : na, "OR High", color=color.green, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(not is_or_calc_bar and not na(or_low) ? or_low : na, "OR Low", color=color.red, linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(not is_or_calc_bar and not na(or_mid) ? or_mid : na, "OR Midpoint Stop", color=color.orange, linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

// =============================================================================
// 2. INDICATOR ENGINE: SUPERTREND, ADX, AND INTRADAY VWAP
// =============================================================================
[st_value, st_direction] = ta.supertrend(st_mult, st_period)
st_bull = st_direction < 0
st_bear = st_direction > 0

[plus_di, minus_di, adx_val] = ta.dmi(adx_len, adx_len)
adx_expansion = adx_val >= adx_thres

cur_vwap = ta.vwap(hlc3)
vwap_slope_up = cur_vwap >= cur_vwap[1]
vwap_slope_dn = cur_vwap <= cur_vwap[1]

// =============================================================================
// 3. SESSION FILTERS & TIME CONTROL
// =============================================================================
in_morning_win   = not na(time(timeframe.period, morn_sess + ":23456", "Asia/Kolkata")) and ((or_len == 15 and t_int >= 930) or (or_len == 30 and t_int >= 945))
in_lunch_zone    = not na(time(timeframe.period, lunch_nop + ":23456", "Asia/Kolkata"))
in_afternoon_win = not na(time(timeframe.period, aft_sess  + ":23456", "Asia/Kolkata"))
is_mis_exit_bar  = not na(time(timeframe.period, mis_exit  + ":23456", "Asia/Kolkata")) or t_int >= 1515

bgcolor(in_morning_win   ? color.new(color.green, 93) : 
        in_lunch_zone    ? color.new(color.purple, 93) : 
        in_afternoon_win ? color.new(color.blue, 93) : na)

// =============================================================================
// 4. POSITION RISK & RATCHET STATE
// =============================================================================
var float entry_price  = na
var float active_stop  = na
var float init_risk    = na
var float target_price = na
var bool  be_locked    = false

if strategy.position_size == 0
    entry_price  := na
    active_stop  := na
    init_risk    := na
    target_price := na
    be_locked    := false

if strategy.position_size > 0
    if not be_locked and high >= entry_price + init_risk * be_trig_r
        active_stop := math.max(active_stop, entry_price + init_risk * be_lock_r)
        be_locked   := true
    if use_trail and st_bull and st_value > active_stop
        active_stop := math.max(active_stop, st_value)

if strategy.position_size < 0
    if not be_locked and low <= entry_price - init_risk * be_trig_r
        active_stop := math.min(active_stop, entry_price - init_risk * be_lock_r)
        be_locked   := true
    if use_trail and st_bear and st_value < active_stop
        active_stop := math.min(active_stop, st_value)

// =============================================================================
// 5. ENTRY EXECUTION LOGIC
// =============================================================================
can_enter_morn = in_morning_win and (morn_trades_today < 1)
can_enter_aft  = in_afternoon_win and (aft_trades_today < 1)
can_enter      = (can_enter_morn or can_enter_aft) and strategy.position_size == 0 and not na(or_high)

long_setup  = can_enter and (close > or_high) and st_bull and adx_expansion and (not use_vwap or (close > cur_vwap and vwap_slope_up))
short_setup = can_enter and (close < or_low)  and st_bear and adx_expansion and (not use_vwap or (close < cur_vwap and vwap_slope_dn))

if long_setup
    entry_price  := close
    active_stop  := or_mid
    init_risk    := math.max(entry_price - active_stop, 10.0)
    target_price := entry_price + target_r * init_risk
    be_locked    := false
    strategy.entry("Long_ORB", strategy.long)
    if in_morning_win
        morn_trades_today += 1
    else
        aft_trades_today += 1

if short_setup
    entry_price  := close
    active_stop  := or_mid
    init_risk    := math.max(active_stop - entry_price, 10.0)
    target_price := entry_price - target_r * init_risk
    be_locked    := false
    strategy.entry("Short_ORB", strategy.short)
    if in_morning_win
        morn_trades_today += 1
    else
        aft_trades_today += 1

// =============================================================================
// 6. EXIT EXECUTION
// =============================================================================
if is_mis_exit_bar and strategy.position_size != 0
    strategy.close_all(comment="MIS Auto-Squareoff")

if strategy.position_size > 0
    strategy.exit("Exit_Long", "Long_ORB", stop=active_stop, limit=target_price, comment_loss="Stop/BE", comment_profit="Target")
    if st_bear
        strategy.close("Long_ORB", comment="ST Flip Exit")

if strategy.position_size < 0
    strategy.exit("Exit_Short", "Short_ORB", stop=active_stop, limit=target_price, comment_loss="Stop/BE", comment_profit="Target")
    if st_bull
        strategy.close("Short_ORB", comment="ST Flip Exit")

// This Pine Script™ code is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public License 2.0 at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/
// © NSE Quant Studio — Champion Strategy #1: Apex MTF Confluence & Volatility Expansion v3 (5m Master)

//@version=5
strategy("Apex MTF Confluence & Volatility Expansion v3 [5m Master]", 
         shorttitle="Apex MTF v3 [5m]", 
         overlay=true, 
         initial_capital=500000, 
         default_qty_type=strategy.fixed, 
         default_qty_value=75, 
         currency=currency.INR, 
         commission_type=strategy.commission.cash_per_order, 
         commission_value=0.0, 
         calc_on_every_tick=false, 
         process_orders_on_close=true, 
         max_labels_count=500, 
         max_lines_count=500)

// ============================================================================
// 1. STRATEGY INPUTS & ARCHITECTURE
// ============================================================================
grp_st       = "1. 5m Supertrend Core Engine"
stPeriod     = input.int(10, "Supertrend ATR Length", minval=1, group=grp_st)
stMult       = input.float(3.5, "Supertrend Multiplier", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=grp_st)

grp_ema      = "2. Intraday & Macro Trend Ribbon"
emaFastP     = input.int(9, "Fast EMA Length", minval=1, group=grp_ema)
emaSlowP     = input.int(21, "Slow EMA Length", minval=1, group=grp_ema)
emaMacroP    = input.int(50, "Intraday Macro EMA Length", minval=1, group=grp_ema)
emaHtfP      = input.int(150, "Higher-TF Structural Baseline EMA (15m=50)", minval=1, group=grp_ema)

grp_filt     = "3. Volatility Expansion, RSI & ADX Chop Filters"
useSpread    = input.bool(true, "Require Candle Volatility Expansion Filter", group=grp_filt)
spreadRatio  = input.float(1.10, "Candle Range vs 20-SMA Ratio", minval=0.5, step=0.05, group=grp_filt)
rsiLen       = input.int(14, "RSI Length", minval=1, group=grp_filt)
rsiBull      = input.float(52.0, "RSI Bull Minimum Threshold", minval=40.0, maxval=70.0, step=0.5, group=grp_filt)
rsiBear      = input.float(48.0, "RSI Bear Maximum Threshold", minval=30.0, maxval=60.0, step=0.5, group=grp_filt)
adxLen       = input.int(14, "ADX Length", minval=1, group=grp_filt)
adxMin       = input.float(18.0, "Minimum ADX Trend Strength", minval=0.0, maxval=50.0, step=1.0, group=grp_filt)
useLunchZone = input.bool(true, "Avoid Midday Lunch Chop Zone (11:30 - 13:00 IST)", group=grp_filt)

grp_risk     = "4. Risk Management, Asymmetric Target & Ratchet"
atrLen       = input.int(14, "ATR Stop Length", minval=1, group=grp_risk)
slAtrMult    = input.float(2.0, "Stop Loss ATR Multiplier (Wick Shield)", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=grp_risk)
minFloorPts  = input.float(25.0, "Minimum Stop Loss Floor (Nifty Pts)", minval=10.0, step=1.0, group=grp_risk)
beTriggerR   = input.float(1.5, "Stage-1 Breakeven Trigger (x Risk R)", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=grp_risk)
beLockR      = input.float(0.35, "Stage-1 Breakeven Lock Profit (+x R)", minval=0.0, step=0.05, group=grp_risk)
targetR      = input.float(4.5, "Profit Target Multiple (x Risk R)", minval=1.0, step=0.5, group=grp_risk)
useStTrail   = input.bool(true, "Enable Dynamic Supertrend Trailing Stop", group=grp_risk)
intradayOnly = input.bool(true, "Strict Intraday MIS Mode (Auto-Exit 15:15 IST)", group=grp_risk)

grp_vis      = "5. Visual Callout Engine & Telemetry HUD"
showCallouts = input.bool(true, "Show BUY CALL / BUY PUT & EXIT Badges", group=grp_vis)
displayLots  = input.int(1, "Display Qty (Lots)", minval=1, group=grp_vis)
lotSize      = input.int(75, "Nifty Lot Size (Units/Lot)", minval=1, group=grp_vis)
showRibbons  = input.bool(true, "Show EMA Trend Overlays", group=grp_vis)
showStLine   = input.bool(true, "Show Supertrend Spine", group=grp_vis)
showTradeLvls= input.bool(true, "Show Active Trade Entry / Stop / Target Lines", group=grp_vis)
showHud      = input.bool(true, "Show Quant Studio Telemetry HUD Table", group=grp_vis)

// ============================================================================
// 2. MATHEMATICAL INDICATORS & VOLATILITY FILTERS
// ============================================================================
emaFast  = ta.ema(close, emaFastP)
emaSlow  = ta.ema(close, emaSlowP)
emaMacro = ta.ema(close, emaMacroP)
emaHtf   = ta.ema(close, emaHtfP)
rsiVal   = ta.rsi(close, rsiLen)

trVal    = ta.tr(true)
atrVal   = ta.rma(trVal, atrLen)
curAtr   = math.max(nz(atrVal, minFloorPts), minFloorPts)

// Range Spread Expansion Filter (filters dead midday chop candles)
candleSpread = high - low
spreadSma20  = ta.sma(candleSpread, 20)
isSpreadExpanded = not useSpread or (candleSpread >= spreadSma20 * spreadRatio)

// Wilder ADX 14 with Directional Movement
upMove   = high - nz(high[1], high)
dnMove   = nz(low[1], low) - low
plusDm   = (upMove > dnMove and upMove > 0) ? upMove : 0.0
minusDm  = (dnMove > upMove and dnMove > 0) ? dnMove : 0.0
adxAtr   = nz(ta.rma(trVal, adxLen), 1.0)
plusDi   = 100.0 * nz(ta.rma(plusDm, adxLen), 0.0) / math.max(adxAtr, 0.0001)
minusDi  = 100.0 * nz(ta.rma(minusDm, adxLen), 0.0) / math.max(adxAtr, 0.0001)
diSum    = plusDi + minusDi
dxVal    = diSum > 0 ? (100.0 * math.abs(plusDi - minusDi) / diSum) : 0.0
adxVal   = nz(ta.rma(dxVal, adxLen), 0.0)
adxTrendOk = (adxMin <= 0.0) or (adxVal >= adxMin)

// Exact Native Non-Repainting Supertrend
stAtr      = ta.rma(trVal, stPeriod)
hl2Val     = (high + low) / 2.0
basicUpper = hl2Val + (stMult * nz(stAtr, 0.0))
basicLower = hl2Val - (stMult * nz(stAtr, 0.0))

var float upperBand = na
var float lowerBand = na
var int   stTrend   = 1
var float stLine    = na

if na(stAtr) or na(upperBand[1]) or bar_index <= stPeriod
    upperBand := basicUpper
    lowerBand := basicLower
    stTrend   := 1
    stLine    := basicLower
else
    upperBand := (basicUpper < upperBand[1] or close[1] > upperBand[1]) ? basicUpper : upperBand[1]
    lowerBand := (basicLower > lowerBand[1] or close[1] < lowerBand[1]) ? basicLower : lowerBand[1]
    if stTrend[1] == 1
        stTrend := close < lowerBand ? -1 : 1
    else
        stTrend := close > upperBand ? 1 : -1
    stLine := stTrend == 1 ? lowerBand : upperBand

// Intraday Equal-Weighted VWAP (Safe for Nifty Spot)
isNewDay = timeframe.change("D")
var float cumHlc3 = 0.0
var int   cumBars = 0
if isNewDay or bar_index == 0
    cumHlc3 := hlc3
    cumBars := 1
else
    cumHlc3 += hlc3
    cumBars += 1
intradayVwap = cumHlc3 / math.max(cumBars, 1)

// Robust IST Time Filter (No fragile session strings)
istHour        = hour(time, "Asia/Kolkata")
istMinute      = minute(time, "Asia/Kolkata")
tInt           = istHour * 100 + istMinute

isLunchZone    = useLunchZone and (tInt >= 1130 and tInt < 1300)
inEntryWindow  = (not intradayOnly or (tInt >= 920 and tInt <= 1430)) and not isLunchZone
isMisSquareoff = intradayOnly and (tInt >= 1515)

// ============================================================================
// 3. CONFLUENCE ENTRY & RATCHET POSITION ENGINE
// ============================================================================
var float entryPrice   = na
var float initRisk     = na
var float activeStop   = na
var float activeTp     = na
var int   ratchetStage = 0
var int   legTrades    = 0

if isNewDay
    legTrades := 0

inLong  = strategy.position_size > 0
inShort = strategy.position_size < 0
flatNow = strategy.position_size == 0

// Trade Management: Exits, Supertrend Trail & Ratchet
if inLong
    // Stage 1: Breakeven Lock at 1.5R
    if beTriggerR > 0 and not na(entryPrice) and not na(initRisk) and high >= (entryPrice + initRisk * beTriggerR)
        beStop = math.round((entryPrice + initRisk * beLockR) * 100.0) / 100.0
        if na(activeStop) or beStop > activeStop
            activeStop   := beStop
            ratchetStage := 1

    // Dynamic Supertrend Trailing Stop
    if useStTrail and stTrend == 1 and not na(stLine) and (na(activeStop) or stLine > activeStop)
        activeStop := math.round(stLine * 100.0) / 100.0

    // Orders Execution
    if not na(activeTp) and not na(activeStop)
        strategy.exit("Long Exit", from_entry="Long", stop=activeStop, limit=activeTp)
    else if not na(activeStop)
        strategy.exit("Long Exit", from_entry="Long", stop=activeStop)

    // Structural Reversal Exit & MIS Auto-Close
    if isMisSquareoff
        strategy.close("Long", comment="MIS Squareoff")
    else if stTrend == -1 and emaFast < emaSlow
        strategy.close("Long", comment="ST Flip Exit")

if inShort
    // Stage 1: Breakeven Lock at 1.5R
    if beTriggerR > 0 and not na(entryPrice) and not na(initRisk) and low <= (entryPrice - initRisk * beTriggerR)
        beStop = math.round((entryPrice - initRisk * beLockR) * 100.0) / 100.0
        if na(activeStop) or beStop < activeStop
            activeStop   := beStop
            ratchetStage := 1

    // Dynamic Supertrend Trailing Stop
    if useStTrail and stTrend == -1 and not na(stLine) and (na(activeStop) or stLine < activeStop)
        activeStop := math.round(stLine * 100.0) / 100.0

    // Orders Execution
    if not na(activeTp) and not na(activeStop)
        strategy.exit("Short Exit", from_entry="Short", stop=activeStop, limit=activeTp)
    else if not na(activeStop)
        strategy.exit("Short Exit", from_entry="Short", stop=activeStop)

    // Structural Reversal Exit & MIS Auto-Close
    if isMisSquareoff
        strategy.close("Short", comment="MIS Squareoff")
    else if stTrend == 1 and emaFast > emaSlow
        strategy.close("Short", comment="ST Flip Exit")

// Entry Trigger Conditions
bullAlign = stTrend == 1 and emaFast > emaSlow and close > emaMacro and close > emaHtf and close > intradayVwap and adxTrendOk and plusDi > minusDi
bearAlign = stTrend == -1 and emaFast < emaSlow and close < emaMacro and close < emaHtf and close < intradayVwap and adxTrendOk and minusDi > plusDi

rsiBullOk = rsiVal >= rsiBull
rsiBearOk = rsiVal <= rsiBear

freshBull = (stTrend[1] == -1) or (emaFast[1] <= emaSlow[1]) or (close > high[1])
freshBear = (stTrend[1] == 1)  or (emaFast[1] >= emaSlow[1]) or (close < low[1])

longCond  = bar_index >= 150 and inEntryWindow and (legTrades < 2) and bullAlign and isSpreadExpanded and rsiBullOk and freshBull
shortCond = bar_index >= 150 and inEntryWindow and (legTrades < 2) and bearAlign and isSpreadExpanded and rsiBearOk and freshBear

bool enteredLongBar  = false
bool enteredShortBar = false

if flatNow and not isMisSquareoff
    if longCond
        entryPrice     := close
        rawRisk        = curAtr * slAtrMult
        initRisk       := math.max(rawRisk, minFloorPts)
        activeStop     := math.round((entryPrice - initRisk) * 100.0) / 100.0
        activeTp       := targetR > 0 ? (math.round((entryPrice + initRisk * targetR) * 100.0) / 100.0) : na
        ratchetStage   := 0
        legTrades      += 1
        enteredLongBar := true
        strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
    else if shortCond
        entryPrice      := close
        rawRisk         = curAtr * slAtrMult
        initRisk        := math.max(rawRisk, minFloorPts)
        activeStop      := math.round((entryPrice + initRisk) * 100.0) / 100.0
        activeTp        := targetR > 0 ? (math.round((entryPrice - initRisk * targetR) * 100.0) / 100.0) : na
        ratchetStage    := 0
        legTrades       += 1
        enteredShortBar := true
        strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)

// ============================================================================
// 4. IMAGE 2 VISUAL CALLOUT ENGINE (BUY CALL / BUY PUT & EXIT PnL BADGES)
// ============================================================================
closedCount = strategy.closedtrades
prevClosed  = nz(closedCount[1], 0)

if showCallouts and closedCount > prevClosed
    for idx = prevClosed to closedCount - 1
        exPrice  = strategy.closedtrades.exit_price(idx)
        enPrice  = strategy.closedtrades.entry_price(idx)
        trSize   = strategy.closedtrades.size(idx)
        ptsDiff  = trSize > 0 ? (exPrice - enPrice) : (enPrice - exPrice)
        isWin    = ptsDiff >= 0
        signStr  = isWin ? "+" : ""
        pillClr  = isWin ? #10b981 : #f43f5e
        exitTxt  = "EXIT\n" + signStr + str.tostring(ptsDiff, "0.0") + " pts"
        wasLong  = trSize > 0
        yExitPos = wasLong ? (high + curAtr * 0.25) : (low - curAtr * 0.25)
        lblStyle = wasLong ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up
        label.new(bar_index, yExitPos, exitTxt, xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, color=pillClr, textcolor=color.white, style=lblStyle, size=size.small)

if showCallouts and enteredLongBar
    callTxt = "BUY CALL\nEntry: " + str.tostring(entryPrice, "0.00") + "\nQty: " + str.tostring(displayLots)
    label.new(bar_index, low - curAtr * 0.35, callTxt, xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, color=#2563eb, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.small)

if showCallouts and enteredShortBar
    putTxt  = "BUY PUT\nEntry: " + str.tostring(entryPrice, "0.00") + "\nQty: " + str.tostring(displayLots)
    label.new(bar_index, high + curAtr * 0.35, putTxt, xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, color=#2563eb, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)

// Chart Overlays
plot(showRibbons ? emaFast  : na, "Fast EMA (9)", color=color.new(#06b6d4, 40), linewidth=1)
plot(showRibbons ? emaSlow  : na, "Slow EMA (21)", color=color.new(#f59e0b, 40), linewidth=1)
plot(showRibbons ? emaMacro : na, "Macro EMA (50)", color=color.new(#818cf8, 45), linewidth=2)
plot(showRibbons ? emaHtf   : na, "HTF Baseline (150)", color=color.new(#ec4899, 45), linewidth=2)
plot(showRibbons ? intradayVwap : na, "Intraday VWAP", color=color.new(#e879f9, 50), linewidth=1, style=plot.style_circles)

stColor = stTrend == 1 ? color.new(#10b981, 20) : color.new(#f43f5e, 20)
plot(showStLine ? stLine : na, "Supertrend Spine", color=stColor, linewidth=2)

// Active Trade Level Lines
inTradeNow = strategy.position_size != 0
plot(showTradeLvls and inTradeNow ? entryPrice : na, "Active Entry", color=color.new(#60a5fa, 20), linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showTradeLvls and inTradeNow ? activeStop : na, "Active Stop / Trail", color=color.new(#fbbf24, 0), linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showTradeLvls and inTradeNow and targetR > 0 ? activeTp : na, "Active Target", color=color.new(#10b981, 20), linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

// ============================================================================
// 5. QUANT STUDIO TELEMETRY HUD TABLE
// ============================================================================
var table hud = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 8, bgcolor=color.new(#0e121b, 8), border_color=color.new(#ffffff, 82), border_width=1)

if barstate.islast and showHud
    totTrades = strategy.closedtrades
    wins      = strategy.wintrades
    winRate   = totTrades > 0 ? (wins / totTrades) * 100.0 : 0.0
    pf        = strategy.grossloss != 0 ? math.abs(strategy.grossprofit / strategy.grossloss) : 0.0
    netInr    = strategy.netprofit
    netPts    = netInr / math.max(lotSize, 1)
    maxDdPts  = strategy.max_drawdown / math.max(lotSize, 1)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 0, "👑 APEX MTF v3 [5M]", text_color=#60a5fa, text_size=size.small, bgcolor=color.new(#1e293b, 10), text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 0, "CHAMPION #1", text_color=#34d399, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(#1e293b, 10), text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 1, "Parameters", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 1, "ST(10,3.5) · EMA(9/21/50/150)", text_color=#e2e8f0, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 2, "Regime · ADX", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 2, (stTrend == 1 ? "BULL" : "BEAR") + " · ADX " + str.tostring(adxVal, "0.0"), text_color=(stTrend == 1 ? #10b981 : #f43f5e), text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 3, "Net Profit (Points)", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 3, (netPts >= 0 ? "+" : "") + str.tostring(netPts, "0.00") + " pts", text_color=(netPts >= 0 ? #10b981 : #f43f5e), text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 4, "Net Profit (1 Lot INR)", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 4, (netInr >= 0 ? "+INR " : "-INR ") + str.tostring(math.abs(netInr), "0"), text_color=(netInr >= 0 ? #10b981 : #f43f5e), text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 5, "Win Rate (Trades)", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 5, str.tostring(winRate, "0.0") + "% (" + str.tostring(totTrades) + ")", text_color=#f8fafc, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 6, "Profit Factor", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 6, str.tostring(pf, "0.00"), text_color=(pf >= 1.35 ? #10b981 : #f8fafc), text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 7, "Max Drawdown", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 7, "-" + str.tostring(maxDdPts, "0.00") + " pts", text_color=#f43f5e, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

maxRiskPts   = input.float(80.0, "Maximum Risk Cap (Nifty Pts)", minval=30.0, step=5.0, group=grp_risk)
targetRIn    = input.float(3.5, "Profit Target Multiple (x Risk R)", minval=1.0, step=0.1, group=grp_risk)
beTriggerRIn = input.float(1.2, "Stage-1 Breakeven Activation (x Risk R)", minval=0.5, step=0.1, group=grp_risk)
beLockRIn    = input.float(0.2, "Stage-1 Breakeven Lock (+x Risk R)", minval=0.0, step=0.05, group=grp_risk)
exitEma21    = input.bool(true, "Enable EMA 21 Structural Trail (Only After 1.2R)", group=grp_risk)
intradayOnly = input.bool(true, "Strict Intraday MIS Mode (Auto-Exit 15:15 IST)", group=grp_risk)

grp_vis      = "4. Visual Callouts & Telemetry HUD"
showCallouts = input.bool(true, "Show BUY CALL / BUY PUT & EXIT Badges", group=grp_vis)
displayLots  = input.int(1, "Display Qty (Lots)", minval=1, group=grp_vis)
lotSize      = input.int(75, "Nifty Lot Size (Units/Lot)", minval=1, group=grp_vis)
showRibbons  = input.bool(true, "Show 4-EMA Ribbon Lines", group=grp_vis)
showTradeLvls= input.bool(true, "Show Entry / Stop / Target Lines", group=grp_vis)
showHud      = input.bool(true, "Show Quant Studio Telemetry HUD Table", group=grp_vis)

// ============================================================================
// 2. MATHEMATICAL INDICATORS & SPREAD VOLATILITY ENGINE
// ============================================================================
emaFast  = ta.ema(close, emaFastP)
emaMed   = ta.ema(close, emaMedP)
emaSlow  = ta.ema(close, emaSlowP)
emaMacro = ta.ema(close, emaMacroP)

trVal    = ta.tr(true)
atrVal   = ta.rma(trVal, 14)
curAtr   = math.max(nz(atrVal, 15.0), 15.0)

// Candle Spread & 20-SMA Filter
candleSpread  = high - low
spreadSma20   = ta.sma(candleSpread, 20)
volSpreadOk   = candleSpread >= (spreadSma20 * spreadMultIn)

// Chaikin Money Flow (Equal-Weighted Index Adapted)
rngSafe      = math.max(high - low, 0.001)
mfMultiplier = ((close - low) - (high - close)) / rngSafe
cmfVal       = ta.sma(mfMultiplier, 20)

// Wilder's ADX 14 with Directional Indicators
upMove   = high - nz(high[1], high)
dnMove   = nz(low[1], low) - low
plusDm   = (upMove > dnMove and upMove > 0) ? upMove : 0.0
minusDm  = (dnMove > upMove and dnMove > 0) ? dnMove : 0.0
adxAtr   = nz(ta.rma(trVal, 14), 1.0)
plusDi   = 100.0 * nz(ta.rma(plusDm, 14), 0.0) / math.max(adxAtr, 0.0001)
minusDi  = 100.0 * nz(ta.rma(minusDm, 14), 0.0) / math.max(adxAtr, 0.0001)
diSum    = plusDi + minusDi
dxVal    = diSum > 0 ? (100.0 * math.abs(plusDi - minusDi) / diSum) : 0.0
adxVal   = nz(ta.rma(dxVal, 14), 0.0)
adxLongOk  = (adxVal >= adxThreshIn) and (plusDi > minusDi)
adxShortOk = (adxVal >= adxThreshIn) and (minusDi > plusDi)

// IST Session Helper
istHour        = hour(time, "Asia/Kolkata")
istMinute      = minute(time, "Asia/Kolkata")
tInt           = istHour * 100 + istMinute
inEntryWindow  = (not intradayOnly) or (tInt >= 920 and tInt <= 1430)
isMisSquareoff = intradayOnly and (tInt >= 1515)

// ============================================================================
// 3. INSTITUTIONAL RIBBON CONFLUENCE CONDITIONS
// ============================================================================
// Ribbon Alignment & Expansion
bullRibbon = (emaFast > emaMed) and (emaMed > emaSlow) and (emaSlow > emaMacro)
bearRibbon = (emaFast < emaMed) and (emaMed < emaSlow) and (emaSlow < emaMacro)

ribbonWidth     = math.abs(emaFast - emaMacro)
ribbonExpanding = ribbonWidth > nz(ribbonWidth[1], ribbonWidth)

cmfLong  = cmfVal >= cmfThreshIn
cmfShort = cmfVal <= -cmfThreshIn

breakoutLong  = (close > high[1]) and (close > open)
breakoutShort = (close < low[1])  and (close < open)

longCond  = inEntryWindow and bullRibbon and ribbonExpanding and cmfLong and volSpreadOk and adxLongOk and breakoutLong
shortCond = inEntryWindow and bearRibbon and ribbonExpanding and cmfShort and volSpreadOk and adxShortOk and breakoutShort

// ============================================================================
// 4. POSITION MANAGEMENT & DELAYED STRUCTURAL RATCHET
// ============================================================================
var float entryPrice       = na
var float initRisk         = na
var float activeStop       = na
var float activeTp         = na
var bool  trailedToEma21   = false

inLong  = strategy.position_size > 0
inShort = strategy.position_size < 0
flatNow = strategy.position_size == 0

// Trade Management: Ratchet Stop & Target
if inLong
    // Only activate trailing to EMA 21 AFTER 1.2R profit is reached
    if high >= (entryPrice + initRisk * beTriggerRIn)
        trailedToEma21 := true
        beStop = math.round((entryPrice + initRisk * beLockRIn) * 100.0) / 100.0
        if na(activeStop) or beStop > activeStop
            activeStop := beStop

    if trailedToEma21 and emaMed > activeStop
        activeStop := math.round(emaMed * 100.0) / 100.0

    if not na(activeTp) and not na(activeStop)
        strategy.exit("Long Exit", from_entry="Long", stop=activeStop, limit=activeTp)
    else if not na(activeStop)
        strategy.exit("Long Exit", from_entry="Long", stop=activeStop)

    if isMisSquareoff
        strategy.close("Long", comment="MIS Exit")
    else if exitEma21 and trailedToEma21 and close < emaMed
        strategy.close("Long", comment="EMA21 Trail Exit")

if inShort
    // Only activate trailing to EMA 21 AFTER 1.2R profit is reached
    if low <= (entryPrice - initRisk * beTriggerRIn)
        trailedToEma21 := true
        beStop = math.round((entryPrice - initRisk * beLockRIn) * 100.0) / 100.0
        if na(activeStop) or beStop < activeStop
            activeStop := beStop

    if trailedToEma21 and emaMed < activeStop
        activeStop := math.round(emaMed * 100.0) / 100.0

    if not na(activeTp) and not na(activeStop)
        strategy.exit("Short Exit", from_entry="Short", stop=activeStop, limit=activeTp)
    else if not na(activeStop)
        strategy.exit("Short Exit", from_entry="Short", stop=activeStop)

    if isMisSquareoff
        strategy.close("Short", comment="MIS Exit")
    else if exitEma21 and trailedToEma21 and close > emaMed
        strategy.close("Short", comment="EMA21 Trail Exit")

bool enteredLong  = false
bool enteredShort = false

// Entry Execution
if flatNow and not isMisSquareoff
    if longCond
        entryPrice     := close
        rawRisk        = math.max(close - (emaSlow - slAtrMultIn * curAtr), minRiskPts)
        initRisk       := math.min(rawRisk, maxRiskPts)
        activeStop     := math.round((entryPrice - initRisk) * 100.0) / 100.0
        activeTp       := math.round((entryPrice + initRisk * targetRIn) * 100.0) / 100.0
        trailedToEma21 := false
        enteredLong    := true
        strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long)
    else if shortCond
        entryPrice     := close
        rawRisk        = math.max((emaSlow + slAtrMultIn * curAtr) - close, minRiskPts)
        initRisk       := math.min(rawRisk, maxRiskPts)
        activeStop     := math.round((entryPrice + initRisk) * 100.0) / 100.0
        activeTp       := math.round((entryPrice - initRisk * targetRIn) * 100.0) / 100.0
        trailedToEma21 := false
        enteredShort   := true
        strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short)

// ============================================================================
// 5. VISUAL CALLOUT ENGINE & OVERLAYS (IMAGE 2 STYLE)
// ============================================================================
closedCount = strategy.closedtrades
prevClosed  = nz(closedCount[1], 0)

if showCallouts and closedCount > prevClosed
    for idx = prevClosed to closedCount - 1
        exPrice  = strategy.closedtrades.exit_price(idx)
        enPrice  = strategy.closedtrades.entry_price(idx)
        trSize   = strategy.closedtrades.size(idx)
        ptsDiff  = trSize > 0 ? (exPrice - enPrice) : (enPrice - exPrice)
        isWin    = ptsDiff >= 0
        signStr  = isWin ? "+" : ""
        pillClr  = isWin ? #10b981 : #f43f5e
        exitTxt  = "EXIT\n" + signStr + str.tostring(ptsDiff, "0.0") + " pts"
        wasLong  = trSize > 0
        yExitPos = wasLong ? (high + curAtr * 0.25) : (low - curAtr * 0.25)
        lblStyle = wasLong ? label.style_label_down : label.style_label_up
        label.new(bar_index, yExitPos, exitTxt, xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, color=pillClr, textcolor=color.white, style=lblStyle, size=size.small)

if showCallouts and enteredLong
    label.new(bar_index, low - curAtr * 0.35, "BUY CALL\nEntry: " + str.tostring(entryPrice, "0.00") + "\nQty: " + str.tostring(displayLots), xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, color=#2563eb, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_up, size=size.small)

if showCallouts and enteredShort
    label.new(bar_index, high + curAtr * 0.35, "BUY PUT\nEntry: " + str.tostring(entryPrice, "0.00") + "\nQty: " + str.tostring(displayLots), xloc=xloc.bar_index, yloc=yloc.price, color=#2563eb, textcolor=color.white, style=label.style_label_down, size=size.small)

plot(showRibbons ? emaFast  : na, "Fast EMA (8)", color=color.new(#06b6d4, 30), linewidth=1)
plot(showRibbons ? emaMed   : na, "Med EMA (21)", color=color.new(#f59e0b, 30), linewidth=1)
plot(showRibbons ? emaSlow  : na, "Slow EMA (55)", color=color.new(#818cf8, 30), linewidth=2)
plot(showRibbons ? emaMacro : na, "Macro EMA (200)", color=color.new(#ec4899, 40), linewidth=2)

inTradeNow = strategy.position_size != 0
plot(showTradeLvls and inTradeNow ? entryPrice : na, "Active Entry", color=color.new(#60a5fa, 20), linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showTradeLvls and inTradeNow ? activeStop : na, "Active Ratchet Stop", color=color.new(#fbbf24, 0), linewidth=2, style=plot.style_linebr)
plot(showTradeLvls and inTradeNow ? activeTp   : na, "Active 3.5R Target", color=color.new(#10b981, 20), linewidth=1, style=plot.style_linebr)

// ============================================================================
// 6. QUANT STUDIO TELEMETRY HUD TABLE
// ============================================================================
var table hud = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 8, bgcolor=color.new(#0e121b, 8), border_color=color.new(#ffffff, 82), border_width=1)

if barstate.islast and showHud
    totTrades = strategy.closedtrades
    wins      = strategy.wintrades
    winRate   = totTrades > 0 ? (wins / totTrades) * 100.0 : 0.0
    pf        = strategy.grossloss != 0 ? math.abs(strategy.grossprofit / strategy.grossloss) : 0.0
    netInr    = strategy.netprofit
    netPts    = netInr / math.max(lotSize, 1)
    maxDdPts  = strategy.max_drawdown / math.max(lotSize, 1)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 0, "👑 APEX RIBBON v3 [5M]", text_color=#60a5fa, text_size=size.small, bgcolor=color.new(#1e293b, 10), text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 0, "CHAMPION #2", text_color=#34d399, text_size=size.tiny, bgcolor=color.new(#1e293b, 10), text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 1, "Ribbon Status", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 1, bullRibbon ? "BULL STACK (8>21>55>200)" : bearRibbon ? "BEAR STACK (8<21<55<200)" : "TRANSITION / CHOP", text_color=bullRibbon ? #10b981 : bearRibbon ? #f43f5e : #e2e8f0, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 2, "CMF · ADX Strength", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 2, "CMF: " + str.tostring(cmfVal, "0.00") + " · ADX: " + str.tostring(adxVal, "0.0"), text_color=#f8fafc, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 3, "Net Profit (Points)", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 3, (netPts >= 0 ? "+" : "") + str.tostring(netPts, "0.00") + " pts", text_color=(netPts >= 0 ? #10b981 : #f43f5e), text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 4, "Net Profit (1 Lot INR)", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 4, (netInr >= 0 ? "+INR " : "-INR ") + str.tostring(math.abs(netInr), "0"), text_color=(netInr >= 0 ? #10b981 : #f43f5e), text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 5, "Win Rate (Trades)", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 5, str.tostring(winRate, "0.0") + "% (" + str.tostring(totTrades) + ")", text_color=#f8fafc, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 6, "Profit Factor", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 6, str.tostring(pf, "0.00"), text_color=(pf >= 1.35 ? #10b981 : #f8fafc), text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)

    table.cell(hud, 0, 7, "Max Drawdown", text_color=#94a3b8, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_left)
    table.cell(hud, 1, 7, "-" + str.tostring(maxDdPts, "0.00") + " pts", text_color=#f43f5e, text_size=size.tiny, text_halign=text.align_right)
